description: Durable identity of live production source and nginx dist roots. Unioned with builtin hardcoded paths in the build guard. Do not treat absence of a server-local marker as permission to build from these paths.

futureMarkerActivation.step: Owner-gated, after this source is merged and deployed as tooling only: create server-local file /home/ubuntu/webapp/TitanGold/.titangold-production-root with mode 0644 containing PRODUCTION_ROOT=YES and a dated token. Do not git-add the marker. The in-repo path list already refuses this root even without the marker.
